scope: Post-hoc RR V1 readiness/evaluation-state reconciliation; this recensus itself runs no model evaluation.

evaluation_ledger.note: Earlier 2026-10-24 recensus statements that #8530 was UNSPENT were incorrect and are superseded by this file. The RR V1 artifact itself states new_configurations_evaluated=1 and exactly matches the frozen config and requested period.

rr_v1_observed_result_at_selection_cost_.interpretation: Historical diagnostic only; not a confirmatory executable validation because V2 fail-closed evidence was unresolved. Frozen version history records V1 as rejected for sparse sample and best-trade dependence.

canonical_2026_mother.note: Existing canonical mother promoted through 2026-10-22 via original-vessel path.

canonical_20261022_promotion.note: Price and institutional available legs promoted into the same canonical mother; margin remains pending/NULL where unavailable.

pit_electronics_2026_and_warmup.note: Preserved old-vessel Q017/E2 electronics history covers 2026 through 2026-10-22, with frozen 2023-2025 official PIT membership as warmup lineage.

macro_sox.note: Existing frozen SOX definition and causal prior-US-session semantics are reproducible through requested end date.

v2_entitlement_identity_execution.note: V2 still does not prove entitlement payment/delivery, listed-security identity transitions, execution allocation/fill, or original first-seen/revision lineage. This does not undo the already-run RR V1 simulation; it limits the evidence grade of that result.

decision.reason: The sole frozen RR V1 configuration was already evaluated once on 2026-10-23. A second run would violate the original one-evaluation contract and would not restore confirmatory status.
decision.next_legal_action: Do not rerun RR V1. Preserve the existing V1 simulation as historical diagnostic evidence. Continue only evidence reconciliation or prospective post-lock collection under a separately frozen protocol; do not reconstruct mother/PIT again and do not tune V1.
